faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RBI Jammu Medical Consultant position?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Medical Consultant post at RBI Jammu is 07 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Consultant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree recognized by the Medical Council of India. A Post Graduate degree in General Medicine is optional, and a minimum of 2 years of experience in practicing medicine is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Medical Consultant position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Medical Consultant position is Rs. 1400 per hour for those with up to 20 years of experience, and Rs. 1800 per hour for those with more than 20 years of experience or an MD qualification.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the RBI Jammu Medical Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. You need to download the application form from the official RBI website, fill it out, and send it along with the required documents via post before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Medical Consultant at Reserve Bank of India, Jammu.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Medical Consultant position at RBI Jammu is contractual.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection process steps?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Medical Consultant role includes an Interview, a Medical Test, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Reserve Bank of India, Jammu located?
faq.answer: The Reserve Bank of India, Jammu is located in Jammu, Jammu and Kashmir, with the pincode 180012.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply online for this position?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment requires an offline application. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.
